INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — MOCK EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Reading 3.2.1 Reading for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 3.2.1 Reading for Information.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading 3.2.1 Reading for Information.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Reading 3.2.1 Reading for Information.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 3.2.1 Reading for Information.

2. When practising Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting.

   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting.

   C. Copy random text without understanding Writing 3.3.1 Sequencing Ideas.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 3.3.1 Sequencing Ideas.

6. In INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid speaking to classmates
   B. Mix random languages with no purpose
   C. Only memorise without using the language
   D. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day

7. When practising Listening for Information: Active and passive voice, which approach is best? (1 mark)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
12. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 6.2.1 Reading Fluency and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 6.3.1 Creative Writing: Poetry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
